$comment: The Claude Code hooks modules can bring; each goes to .claude/hooks/<name>. Each entry says where it comes from and where it goes: `install` (a command), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits), and `output` (the path, or paths, it writes in the project). An install runs when one of its outputs is missing; outputs go when no module needs the entry any more. An entry with no source is written by another entry's `install` (its output is in that entry's `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out. apply.mjs writes `event`, `matcher`, `timeout` and `statusMessage` into .claude/settings.json and `describe` into .claude/harness.md ({checks} and {fileChecks} become the project's checks).

session-start.describe: (session start, resume or clear): reports whether dependencies are installed, whether a dev server already runs, and how many files are uncommitted.

guard-commands.describe: (before every Bash command): blocks force push and skipping git hooks (`--no-verify`, `SKIP_VERIFY`).

format-lint-file.describe: (after every edit): {fileChecks} on the edited file.

check-all.describe: (end of every turn): {checks}; skipped when only `.md` files changed or the same code already passed.
